title: 2024 Egyptian-Japanese radar survey finds L-shaped structure near Great Pyramid

tellings.quote: In 2024, a collaborative effort between Egyptian and Japanese researchers using ground penetrating radar and electrical resistivity tomography mapped the western cemetery adjacent to the Great Pyramid.

plain: In 2024, a team of Egyptian and Japanese researchers is said to have found an L-shaped structure underground in the western cemetery next to the Great Pyramid of Giza. Michels describes the survey himself: the team used ground-penetrating radar, which sends radio waves into the earth, and electrical resistivity tomography, which maps what lies below by passing electric current through the ground. He brings it up as a sign that more may be hidden under the site than is known.
